questions.prompt: Which work does Ms. Weaver want Anna to return to?
questions.evidence: So, I want you to go back to hosting and reporting.
questions.explanation: go back to 表示回到原来的工作；明确提到主持和采访报道。直升机是 Anna 开头不想做的例外，写书是 Pete 的经历，都不是给 Anna 的安排。

spokenEvidence.quote: So, I want you to go back to hosting and reporting.

questions.prompt: Why does Anna think Pete is suitable as her partner?
questions.evidence: But the person must be different from me. So, I thought of you.
questions.explanation: different from me 是选搭档的条件，而不是要求性格相同。老板认为 Anna 开朗善交际，Pete 的反差正符合这个安排；没有说他管理摄影棚。
answers: His personality is different from hers.
options: His personality is different from hers.
He has the same cheerful personality.
He already manages the whole studio.

spokenEvidence.quote: But the person must be different from me. So, I thought of you.

questions.prompt: What has Pete actually been working on when Anna tears the paper?
questions.evidence: Anna, I was working on that crossword puzzle.
questions.explanation: Anna 以为纸上只有招聘广告，于是撕掉；Pete 说明自己做的是 crossword puzzle，即填字游戏。这是两个人理解不同造成的误会。
options: A travel plan for Ms. Weaver.

spokenEvidence.quote: Anna, I was working on that crossword puzzle.

questions.prompt: What time is Pete’s interview the following morning? Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS.
questions.evidence: Your interview is tomorrow morning at 10 am.
questions.explanation: tomorrow morning 表示次日上午，具体钟点是10 am。题目问时间，不是地址或职位名称；保留 am 可明确上午。

spokenEvidence.quote: Your interview is tomorrow morning at 10 am.

questions.prompt: What did Pete do while writing his book?
questions.evidence: I didn't speak to anybody the entire time!
questions.explanation: didn’t speak to anybody 是全程没有和任何人说话，结合他把自己关在小屋写书，可知他独自写作。不要把 Anna 擅长的采访主持套到 Pete 的写书经历。
answers: He stayed alone without speaking to anyone.
options: He stayed alone without speaking to anyone.
He interviewed many people every day.
He hosted a cheerful talk show.

spokenEvidence.quote: I didn't speak to anybody the entire time!

questions.prompt: What is the result of Pete’s interview?
questions.explanation: Pete 先转述老板说自己脾气不太好、不善与人相处，随后说自己得到工作；这些特征恰好形成搭档反差。不能只听到负面性格描述就推断落选。
answers: He gets the job despite being described as grumpy.
options: He is rejected for not being cheerful.
He refuses to meet Ms. Weaver.
He gets the job despite being described as grumpy.
